pages.text: Mariculture interacts with Neo Vitae through the Bound Fishing Rod, which can really help you out when it comes to fishing.
pages.title: Neo Vitae Integration
Binding
pages.text: Put a $(item)Titanium Fishing Rod$() into a binding array with a $(item)Reagent of Binding$().
$(l)Bound Fishing Rod$()$(br)The bound fishing rod is bound in an alchemy array from a Titanium Fishing Rod and a Reagent of Binding. Repair it with a Tabula Rasa.

The bound fishing rod works exceptionally well. It is even able to catch some fish species alive that you would normally have to breed. Sneak and use it to activate it; when activated and a weak blood shard sits next to it in the hotbar, each use catches up to 9 fish from the water around you. It can also catch Neo Vitae loot.
$(l)Bait$()$(br)$(li)Rotten Flesh$(li)Weak Blood Shard (also powers the activated rod)
